description: This file contains shared utilities, constants, and helper functions for scaled matrix multiplication benchmarks in a PyTorch testing environment. It includes functions to import test modules dynamically, handle FP8 data types, generate group offsets, and check platform support for specific features. The file modularizes common code used across multiple benchmark scripts, focusing on performance testing and feature detection related to scaled matrix operations.

methods.name: ModuleType get_test_scaled_matmul_cuda()
methods.description: Dynamically imports and caches the test_scaled_matmul_cuda module from the test directory, allowing reuse of helper functions for scaled matrix multiplication benchmarks.

methods.name: get_float8_dtype(float8_dtype)
methods.description: Normalizes the FP8 data type alias to an internal torch data type, handling various alias strings and types.

methods.name: torch.Tensor build_equal_k_group_offs(total_k: int, groups: int, device: str)
methods.description: Creates a tensor of group end offsets for partitioning the K dimension into equal parts, useful for grouped matrix multiplications.

methods.name: bool supports_fp8_deepseek_blockwise_scaling()
methods.description: Checks whether the current platform and CUDA version support DeepSeek-style FP8 blockwise scaling, typically only on specific GPU architectures.
